fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the FWLM serve as the backbone of provincial defense across a patchwork of semi-autonomous states, each maintaining its own military traditions and equipment preferences. Hover-mechanized platoons are the fastest infantry transport in FWLM service, carrying troops across water and open terrain at speeds that outpace any ground vehicle. Their vulnerability to ambush in confined terrain is offset by the tactical flexibility they offer on League worlds with extensive coastlines or open plains. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that deliver sustained automatic fire at close range, these platoons trade precision for volume, putting enough rounds downrange to suppress enemy positions and deny open ground to advancing troops.
